edition.notes: A dated official English delivery state containing the complete motu proprio, its articles 1-12, and its 7 July 2007 date. The promulgated Latin is the authoritative text.
edition.publication: Holy See English web presentation of Summorum Pontificum, retrieved 2026-07-25
edition.title: Summorum Pontificum — Vatican English web state

passages.context: The complete English motu proprio, including article 1 on the ordinary and extraordinary expressions of the one lex orandi and the statement that the 1962 typical edition was never abrogated, article 2 on Masses without the people, article 5 on parishes with stably existing groups, articles 7-12 on recourse to the Ecclesia Dei Commission, and the 14 September 2007 effective date.
passages.notes: The complete delivery was structurally inspected; no comparison with a printed Acta witness is claimed.

alternate_titles: Apostolic Letter given Motu Proprio on the use of the Roman liturgy prior to the reform of 1970
work.author: Pope Benedict XVI
work.description: Benedict XVI's apostolic letter given motu proprio on 7 July 2007, effective 14 September 2007, designating the Missal of Paul VI the ordinary expression and the 1962 Missal an extraordinary expression of the lex orandi of the Roman Rite and regulating the latter's use.
work.title: Summorum Pontificum
